confirmedDefect: The Dell QA process selects R2StorageService while all required R2 configuration values are absent.
directEvidence: Authorized JPEG and WEBP requests reached UploadController and R2StorageService.
R2StorageService.EnsureConfigured threw before client creation or PutObjectAsync.
All canonical R2 settings are absent from the API process and appsettings.QA.json.
Dell /health/ready reports r2 Unhealthy: Cloudflare R2 is not fully configured.
affectedComponent: Dell QA runtime configuration for PointOfSale.API storage
expectedBehavior: QA uses the intended Cloudflare R2 provider and completes upload before product-media registration.
approvedMinimalFix: Provision canonical R2 settings using a Dell-side secret source and restart only the API.
optionalSetting: R2_PUBLIC_URL; when absent, product media can use the authenticated application serving route.
regressionRisk: Incorrect endpoint, bucket, credentials, or permissions can keep readiness unhealthy or cause S3 errors. Restarting only the API briefly interrupts Dell API traffic.
status: blocked: no approved credential-bearing source or values are accessible
